BYTE/ BACKEND WEB DEVELOPMENT — ALTERNATIVE WEBSITE
A completely different dark indigo and lime visual style.

Files:
- index.html
- theme.css
- main.js
- course-data.js

Extract the ZIP, keep all files together, and open index.html in a browser.
Search, unit filtering, sidebar navigation and copy-code buttons are included.

Code examples are shown for study; PHP/SQL does not execute inside this static site.
To run PHP/MySQL programs, use a local PHP/MySQL environment such as XAMPP.

Syllabus units covered:
I. Internet technologies, protocols, HTML, JavaScript and scripting types
II. PHP syntax, variables, data types, operators, decisions, loops and strings
III. HTML forms, GET/POST, registration and login validation
IV. MySQL connectivity, database/table creation, insertion, retrieval and manipulation
